In `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (`src/main/java/.../rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java:173`), the create audit line now also logs `membershipLevel` and `membershipNumber`, while keeping the fields it already carried (`id`, `customerCode`, `registrationDate`, `membershipLevel`):

```java
AUDIT.info("owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={} membershipNumber={}",
    owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(), ownerDto.getMembershipLevel(),
    ownerDto.getMembershipNumber());
```

Both new values come from the already-mapped `ownerDto`, so the number matches the same derivation exposed via the API (e.g. `NSW-16E6609E-M26`). The new `Cp43Tests` and all existing tests pass.
